Lessons.Title: Solve Problems Involving Large Numbers
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will solve problems that involve adding and subtracting multi-digit numbers.
In this lesson, you apply your skills and understandings for adding and subtracting large numbers to solve problems and participate in a game. - Action and Expression
Core relationship: Solve contextual large-number problems. Choose operations from the relationships, not from the sizes of the numbers alone.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  True or False: Sums and Differences	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  The Fundraiser	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  The Least and the Greatest of Them All	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Populations of Three Cities	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: A fundraiser collects 24,000 and 17,500 and spends 8,500. What remains?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Explain how to check the remaining amount using addition.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Adding all quantities when an expense must be subtracted.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: It changes the unit, place value, or operation.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Choose operations from the relationships, not from the sizes of the numbers alone.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Stopping after the first step of a multi-step problem.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: The mathematical operation or unit interpretation is incorrect.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Execute every given change in order.
